Fixed: with the Find mod installed, Shift+F on the map froze the map until the mod was switched off and on. Reported by ecktos1.
Settable keys: [Keys] in minimap_config.ini now has Glow= (G G's key, G at first) and MinimapMouse= (the keys held for the minimap's mouse, Shift+Alt at first). Requested by izisot.
Info bar: with a minimap smaller than the default, the time, weather and buttons shrink with it and stay inside its border, Ornate and Thin. Requested by yassifecade.
Controllers: pads that are not XInput are looked for once, then again only when a device is plugged in or out, no longer every 200 ms while the map is open (that could play the Windows device sound). WindowsJoysticks=false under [General] turns the check off. Reported by TillYouCry.
Fixed: PotatoPC=true added under the PotatoPC=false line the mod writes was ignored; the last PotatoPC line counts now. Reported by TillYouCry.
Fixed: the log's first line said version 1.3.26 since that version.
